No cosmetic reskins or borrowed franchise props. These original studies explore different feeding surfaces, refill paths and mounting arrangements. They have not been modeled, printed or validated.

    EVIDENCE, NOT BESTSELLER CLAIMS

    Designed for more than our own taste.

    Adjacent-market signals inform these original themes. They are not measurements of NestForge demand or bird-feeder sales. We prioritize recent, related evidence over sheer enthusiasm, and preserve lower-evidence ideas as comparison tests.

    Whimsy item searches rose 110% in Etsy’s reported comparison. Three months to September 14, 2026 versus the same period a year earlier; marketplace-wide, not feeder-specific. Read the source →

    Reality check: the existing feeder market

    • Uncommon Goods birdhouses and feeders: The retailer lists a Tree Wizard Bird Feeder at $34 and a glass-house feeder. This confirms a real decorative-feeder category, not demand for a NestForge design. The mushroom item is a nester, not a feeder, so it is not treated as a direct competitor.
    • Perky-Pet official feeder catalog: The official range separates decorative, hopper, mesh and platform feeders. The Country House feeder is listed at $39.99. These finished-product prices are not comparable to a digital file or a full-spool shopping estimate.

    Official-store observations from October 23, 2026. Listings show category presence, not units sold or willingness to pay for these concepts.

    Next validation: compare equal-quality mockups with people who actually feed birds; ask which they would print or buy, what they would pay, and what would make cleaning or refill easier. Do not label a favorite a bestseller or develop expensive CAD from aesthetic search growth alone.

    Current shopper demand is still unmeasured for these exact ideas. No fabricated reviews, popularity counters, licensed partnerships, stock or finished-product availability are presented.
